```{r}
rm(list=ls())

### Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(rje)
library(parallel)
library(forcats)
library(sjPlot)
library(sjmisc)
library(sjlabelled)
library(performance)

### Read in and clean data
dats.orig = read_csv('Data/AnalysisData/specieslevel_analysisdata_final.csv')

dats=dats.orig |>
  drop_na(climPC1,climPC2) |>  # only drop site groups missing climate PCs -- keep everything else unfiltered,
  # unlike the species cover models (no abs(changecover)<=20 filter, no drop_na on lat range cols -- that drops Draba heilii)
  filter(startcover!=0|endcover!=0) |>  # remove cases where a species did not have start or end cover
  mutate(parksummit = paste(park,summit,sep="."),
         PSaspect = paste(park,summit,aspect,sep=".")) |>
  select( -c(family,genus,species,perenneating,leaves,habit,taxunit,starts_with("lat"),expanded,contracted,nochange) )
names(dats)

mod.dats <- dats |>
  group_by(park,summit,aspect,transition,startyear) |>
  mutate(start.nspp = n_distinct(sciname[which(startcover > 0)]),
         end.nspp = n_distinct(sciname[which(endcover > 0)]),
         change.nspp = end.nspp - start.nspp,
         gains = n_distinct(sciname[which(startcover == 0 & endcover > 0)]),
         losses = n_distinct(sciname[which(startcover > 0 & endcover == 0)])) |>
  select(-c(sciname,startcover,endcover,changecover,propchangecover,startcover0,endcover0,no0)) |>
  unique()
names(mod.dats)
table(mod.dats$park,mod.dats$summit)

mod.dats$park = factor(mod.dats$park,levels=c("GNP","YNP","RMN","GSD","PEC"))
```

## Direction test: did richness change overall, and by park?
```{r direction_test}

dir.mod = lmer(change.nspp ~ 1 + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = TRUE)
summary(dir.mod)

park.mod = lmer(change.nspp ~ 0 + park + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = TRUE)
summary(park.mod)

```

## Gains and losses
```{r gains_losses}

gl.dats = mod.dats |>
  select(park,summit,aspect,PSaspect,transition,gains,losses) |>
  pivot_longer(cols=c(gains,losses),names_to="type",values_to="count") |>
  mutate(type = factor(type,levels=c("gains","losses")))

mean(mod.dats$gains); mean(mod.dats$losses)

gl.mod = glmer(count ~ type + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = gl.dats,family = poisson)
summary(gl.mod)
check_overdispersion(gl.mod)

```

Vascular plant cover models have very few predictor variables, so model selection is much simpler
- Fixed effects are start richness, climate variables, and site latitude -- here
- Park is left out of driver models (not just here): within-park SD of sitelat is 0.003-0.17 degrees, so sitelat and park are nearly redundant, and sitelat is the finer-grained of the two
- Random effect options are PSaspect and transition
```{r REstructure}

### Compare RE options with a fully saturated FE structure

# PS aspect random slope
mod1 = lmer(end.nspp~start.nspp*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|PSaspect),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = TRUE)

# transition as random slope
mod2 = lmer(end.nspp~start.nspp*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = TRUE)

# both as random slopes
mod3 = lmer(end.nspp~start.nspp*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = TRUE)

# Compare AICc values
mod.compare = AICc(mod1,mod2,mod3) |> mutate(delta = AICc-min(AICc)) |> arrange(delta)
mod.compare

##### Refit the best RE structure above with ML and dredge
mod2.ML = lmer(end.nspp~start.nspp*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|transition),
                  na.action = "na.fail",data = mod.dats,REML = F)

## Dredge the model that was refit with maximum likelihood
mod2.dredge = dredge(mod2.ML,beta = c("none"),fixed = c('start.nspp'),trace=2)

##### Pull best model from dredge #####
best.PC.mod = get.models(mod2.dredge,subset = 1)[[1]]
best.PC.mod@call

rm(mod1,mod2,mod3,mod2.dredge,mod2.ML)
```


Sub in climate vars for climPC1

3. Take that model with the optimal FE and RE structure, remove random slopes and find best explicit climate variables in nested loops
```{r best.clim.vars, warning=FALSE}

# Create climate variable variable groups
val = c("min","max","mean")
tmean.grp = append(paste0(val,".tmean"),NA)
snow.gdd.grp = append(c(paste0(val,".gdd"),paste0(val,".snowdays")),NA)
ppt.grp = append(paste0(val,".gs.ppt"),NA)
cwd.grp =  append(c(paste0(val,".aet"),paste0(val,".pet"),paste0(val,".wy.ppt")),NA)
rm(val)

# to see number of combinations (the "." placeholder below needs %>%, not |>)
clim.combos.df = expand_grid(tmean.grp,snow.gdd.grp,ppt.grp,cwd.grp) %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.))!=ncol(.))

climVar.generic.mod = "end.nspp~start.nspp*(tmean.var + cwd.var + ppt.var + snow.gdd.var + sitelat) + (1|transition)"

# In each iteration, a single climate variable from each group is subbed in for the generic climate variables above (i.e., tmean.var is swapped out for mean.tmean). That model is then fit with ML (not REML) and the AIC value is stored in the output table for comparison once the loops are finished running

# Store results
clim.mod.AICs = NULL

for(i in 1:nrow(clim.combos.df)){

  tmean.i = clim.combos.df$tmean.grp[i]
  cwd.i = clim.combos.df$cwd.grp[i]
  ppt.i = clim.combos.df$ppt.grp[i]
  snow.gdd.i = clim.combos.df$snow.gdd.grp[i]

  # If all clim vals are NA skip to next loop
  if(is.na(tmean.i)&is.na(cwd.i)&is.na(ppt.i)&is.na(snow.gdd.i)) next

  clim.mod.i = climVar.generic.mod

  # either remove tmean.var or replace with specific tmean variable name. Repeat the same process for all other clim variable groups
  if(is.na(tmean.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "tmean.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "tmean.var",replacement = tmean.i,x = clim.mod.i)}

  if(is.na(cwd.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "cwd.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "cwd.var",replacement = cwd.i,x = clim.mod.i)}

  if(is.na(ppt.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "ppt.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "ppt.var",replacement = ppt.i,x = clim.mod.i)}

  if(is.na(snow.gdd.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = " + snow.gdd.var",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "snow.gdd.var",replacement = snow.gdd.i,x = clim.mod.i)}

  out_df = data.frame(tmean.var = tmean.i,
              snow.gdd.var = snow.gdd.i,
              ppt.var = ppt.i,
              cwd.var = cwd.i,
              mod.str = clim.mod.i)

  # Fit in LMER
  mod.fit.i = lmer(formula = clim.mod.i, data = mod.dats, REML = FALSE, na.action = "na.fail")

  out_df$AICc=AICc(mod.fit.i)
  out_df$condR2 = r2(mod.fit.i)[[1]]
  out_df$margR2 = r.squaredGLMM(mod.fit.i)[[2]]

  clim.mod.AICs = rbind(clim.mod.AICs,out_df)
  rm(out_df,clim.mod.i)

}

## add a delta AIC column
clim.mod.AICs$delta = clim.mod.AICs$AICc-min(clim.mod.AICs$AICc)

## Pull out model string for model with lowest AIC
best.ExplClimVar.mod.str <- clim.mod.AICs$mod.str[clim.mod.AICs$delta==0]

## Fit that model again and put in global env
best.ExplClimVar.mod = lmer(best.ExplClimVar.mod.str, data = mod.dats, REML = FALSE, na.action = "na.fail")

## Dredge that model
dredge.climVar.mod = dredge(best.ExplClimVar.mod,beta = c("none"),fixed = c('start.nspp'),trace=2)

## Pull out best model from dredge and refit with REML for parameter estimates
best.climVar.mod = get.models(dredge.climVar.mod,subset=1)[[1]]
best.climVar.mod@call

final.climVar.mod = best.climVar.mod
summary(final.climVar.mod)

## Compare to start richness only, as a baseline
start.only.mod = lmer(end.nspp~start.nspp + (1|transition), data = mod.dats, REML = FALSE, na.action = "na.fail")
AICc(final.climVar.mod,start.only.mod)

```


```{r}
sjPlot::plot_model(final.climVar.mod,type = "pred")
```
